shared_elements: schematic human/anthropomorphic figures with raised or outstretched arms
a row of repeated similar figures along a horizontal register
justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic figures — humanoid forms with raised arms, animals in profile, and disc-like circular elements — plus in each case a row of repeated similar forms (boats with crew strokes in A, a band of crouching quadrupeds and arcaded shapes in B). But the actual content diverges strongly: A is dominated by boats, sun/wheel discs, spear- and horn-carrying human figures scattered freely across the rock, while B is a vertical zoned composition of animals (quadruped, bird, snake-like and fox-like creatures) in stacked registers with no boats, no discs held by figures, and no human actors, so the correspondences are of the universal schematic kind rather than a shared iconographic scheme.
